title: 好欸拍手
editing_notes: 造型来自 B 站《好欸好欸》《对对对》两张 PNG 的直接视觉条件。拍手动作由子代理分镜重画。

keys.prompt:
Make ONE precise production keyframe sheet of NINE sequential animation illustrations. EXACTLY 3 columns and 3 rows of 512x512 SQUARE cells, total 1536x1536; read row major. Invisible equal grid divisions, absolutely no written text, numbers, lettering, panel frames or gutters. Each cell has exactly the same fixed lens, solid opaque pure WHITE background, mild safe margins and fixed ground line. Draw the reference character(s) large, with the same recognizable face design, costume, hair and accessories across the 9 cells. Only characters requested in the story. Draw graphic chibi animation cels with clean shapes, not a close-up collage, no motion blur. Each cell must show a DIFFERENT complete acting pose. This is one story with a readable pay-off and reset, including hands, gaze and props. At small chat scale every pose reads. STORY: Single silver gray bob Xingtong, crossed clips and sailor collar. Little knee dip, joyful hands clearly apart in front of chest, accelerate palms together, single clean contact on centerline, separate, soft rebound of short hair. Tight stable half-body.
NINE chronological drawings: 1) 0.00 s: Draw Xingtong waist-up with a silver gray bob, crossed clips, sailor collar, forward gaze, joyful smile, and inward-facing palms 24 cm apart before her chest; begin a tiny knee dip. 2) 0.65 s: Lower her torso slightly through the knee dip, keeping both hands fully visible and apart; let the bob tips lag upward. 3) 1.20 s: Deepen the small dip, brighten her open smile, and spread her palms to 28 cm apart at chest height. 4) 1.60 s: Begin rising and bring her palms inward to a 20 cm gap, keeping fingers relaxed and wrists aligned. 5) 1.78 s: Rise farther and accelerate both palms inward to a 14 cm gap; trail the bob tips slightly downward. 6) 1.90 s: Make one clean palm-to-palm contact on the chest centerline, with aligned fingers, visible wrists, and a delighted expression. 7) 2.15 s: Separate both palms to a 12 cm gap, soften the elbows, and let the short hair bounce gently upward. 8) 3.20 s: Open the hands to a 24 cm gap while settling upright; let the bob tips rebound softly downward. 9) 4.45 s: Settle the bob and hold the hands 22 cm apart, with the torso slightly higher than pose one, ready to ease into its dip.
Continuity: Maintain a fixed tight half-body view throughout the 4.70-second loop, consistent clips, collar, forward gaze and visible empty hands, one clap, and a smooth seam between distinct adjacent poses nine and one. ATTACHMENT AUTHORITY: the left subject is directly illustrated from the real Bilibili official pack Xingtong 好欸好欸 and 对对对: use her squat round silver-grey bob shape, big angular silver side-swept bang, small loop-shaped crossing slim hairpins on the viewer-right, dark plum tapered ink, broad warm red cheeks, low-set eyes with lively lash detail, dark navy sleeves and white sailor collar with powder-blue trim. Closely follow the shape and color blocks in the small original stickers. Omit their printed writing and onomatopoeia. Do not use generic idol character design. Where the reference shows no pupils for a gag, preserve that deliberate feature in the nod; ordinary open eyes of Xingtong are blue. Nailü, whenever requested, uses the taupe, green, white-flower figure at RIGHT of the guide. Do not draw the attachment collage as a new scene. Nailü has exactly ONE brown HEART-SHAPED COWLICK attached to the top of the head. Hair flowers and green bang streak match the right-side guide; absolutely NO floating green wavy symbols above her head. Her eye direction and smiles vary with the scene.

strip-0.prompt:
Act as a senior 2D inbetween animator. Return a continuous production sheet in EXACTLY the same layout as this reference: THREE columns, FOUR rows, TWELVE equally sized complete square images, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Fill every square with one fully drawn camera-locked scene. Its white background, screen coordinates, character scale, clothing and props agree with the reference. No grids, numbering, words, motion trails, crossfades or double hands. The attached four rows give A, B, B, C. Create TWO successive micro-actions: top TWO rows are SIX evenly spaced DIFFERENT complete inbetween poses from the first reference A toward B, bottom TWO rows are SIX from B toward C. The six progress values in EACH block are about 10%,26%,42%,58%,74%,90%. Source extremes are supplied separately in the final GIF, so fill ALL cells with precision motion, never six identical drawings. Follow bright clean line art and maintain exact registration and hand identity; no autonomous camera shake. Full story for context: Single silver gray bob Xingtong, crossed clips and sailor collar. Little knee dip, joyful hands clearly apart in front of chest, accelerate palms together, single clean contact on centerline, separate, soft rebound of short hair. Tight stable half-body.
A = 0.00 s: Draw Xingtong waist-up with a silver gray bob, crossed clips, sailor collar, forward gaze, joyful smile, and inward-facing palms 24 cm apart before her chest; begin a tiny knee dip.
B = 0.65 s: Lower her torso slightly through the knee dip, keeping both hands fully visible and apart; let the bob tips lag upward.
C = 1.20 s: Deepen the small dip, brighten her open smile, and spread her palms to 28 cm apart at chest height.
Trust the actual illustrated poses in the attachment for the shape, timing and exact action. Preserve figure count and source costume. Never place hands, limbs or extra flowers into adjacent cells.
